one_line: In #51, forced context erasures of a memeplex's hosts do not lower its expression share (1/14 distributed memeplexes lose >= 10%; median +0.05 [0.00, 0.12]); host classes are mostly a generic topic cost, and hub/operator tests are untestable or descriptive.
